memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: Israel served the Lord throughout the lifetime of Joshua and of the elders who outlived him and who had experienced everything the Lord had done for Israel. And Joseph's bones, which the Israelites had brought up from Egypt, were buried at Shechem in the tract of land that Jacob bought from the sons of Hamor, the father of Shechem, for a hundred pieces of silver. So it became the inheritance of Joseph's descendants. — Josh 24:31-32 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
Two burials, two testimonies of faith. First we learn that Israel served the Lord as long as Joshua and the elders who had seen God's works were alive. This is both encouraging and sobering. Encouraging, because a generation stayed faithful. Sobering, because their faithfulness was tied to memory — and the book of Judges soon shows what happened when a generation arose that did not remember.

Then there are Joseph's bones. Centuries earlier, Joseph had made his brothers promise to carry his bones out of Egypt when God brought them to the promised land (Gen 50:25). Now, at last, that promise is kept. Joseph had died in Egypt believing in a homeland he would not live to see. His bones being buried in Canaan is a quiet monument to faith that trusts God across generations. Indeed, the New Testament honors Joseph precisely for this dying act of faith (Heb 11:22).

Both stories press the same question on us: will we remember, and will we trust God for what we may not live to see? Faith must be passed on and held onto, or it fades. And true faith looks beyond our own lifetime to the promises of God.

Keep the memory of God's faithfulness alive in your home. Trust Him, like Joseph, for a future you may not fully see. God keeps His promises, even across the centuries.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Is your faith tied to a living memory of God's faithfulness?
2. How can you keep that memory alive for the next generation?
3. Like Joseph, can you trust God for promises beyond your own lifetime?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Faithful God, help me to remember all You have done and to pass that memory on. Give me faith like Joseph's, trusting You for what I may not live to see. Amen.
